what: Decided as the brain to keep job planning on despite the keep rule (D110, job-planning.md section 9): the landed share of planned jobs is 28 of 51 (55%), below the 64% baseline the rule holds it to. The comparison is confounded: most planned jobs since 2026-10-24 were records-history infrastructure (landing, history check, cutover), harder than the baseline's mix, and planning stops cost about $1 against $3 to $5 for a failed build. Revisit when athena status evaluates the rule (request 20261025-033740-5d0n) and on a like-for-like mix.
why: The rule's trigger was crossed without anyone evaluating it; turning planning off now would remove the critic that caught real design gaps in two-thirds of jobs.
